description: Delete XML elements, comments or processing instructions (Structure pane menu > Delete), or untag elements, keeping their content in the layout (Untag Element). Deleting an element deletes the content tagged to it, as the Structure pane does

ids.description: Ids of elements, comments or instructions (from list_xml_structure)

mode.description: delete removes the items; untag removes the elements but keeps their content

selection.description: Or also: the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: Or also: every element this XPath expression matches

name: remove_xml_items
title: Remove XML Items
